task_title: Relocate sprite sidecar lifecycle into shared extension supervisor

plan_review.notes: Rejected extension-owned child lifecycle. Alt A repo-scoped ensure manager adopted: one atomic registry/lock and one launch path shared by canvases, sprites:run, and sprites:gallery. Alt B single host extension rejected because existing canvases are independent processes and consolidation would expand UI scope. Alt C sidecar-only singletonization partially adopted through token provenance and managed shutdown, but callers still need a common ensure command. Revised plan adds canonical repo identity, token-authenticated provenance, strict worker/ingester readiness, immediate degraded canvas paint followed by hydration, bounded sanitized logs, cross-process/race/crash/wrong-repo/stale/bootstrap coverage, and persistent worktree-scoped lifecycle with explicit stop/stale replacement rather than per-canvas ownership.
